reason: The price is actually on the page and 59 € a month isn't crazy, but I'd book the free demo, maybe try the free plan, and not pay until I see it answering my own customer emails properly. 'AI co-workers' sounds great until one sends a wrong reply to a client.
objection: I don't believe it will learn my business well enough to act without me checking everything, and if I have to check everything it saves me nothing. Also I don't know what 100 credits actually gets me.
would_change_my_mind: The Customer Success person setting it up on my real inbox and CRM during the demo, and showing me a week of real results before I pay.
